task_description: Analysis of SXS binary black hole simulation catalog waveform differences
scientific_goal: Construct high-accuracy, high-coverage catalog of BBH simulations for gravitational-wave data analysis, waveform model calibration, and fundamental physics research

fig6_data.description: Waveform differences between two highest numerical resolutions
fig6_data.purpose: Assess overall numerical uncertainty of waveform catalog

fig7_data.description: Waveform differences decomposed by spherical harmonic mode l=2 to l=8
fig7_data.purpose: Understand how waveform accuracy varies across multipoles

quantitative_summaries: Distribution statistics for fig6 (median, mean, std, percentiles)
Mode-by-mode statistics for fig7 (per l median and scatter)
comparison_tables: Summary statistics table comparing all three datasets
figure_families: Data overview: histograms and KDE plots for each dataset
Main results: cumulative distributions, box plots by mode
Validation: QQ plots, extrapolation convergence plots
interpretability_artifacts: Error budget breakdown by source (resolution, mode, extrapolation)
Correlation analysis between different error sources

methodological_commitments.reproducibility: All code saved to code/, outputs saved to outputs/
methodological_commitments.related_work_integration: Compare findings to SXS catalog paper methodology
